WHAT THE STALE ID COST, so the class is on record here too: check-connectors resolves each id against marketplace.json and reports one the marketplace no longer declares as an [INFO] -- correct, deliberate (August 9, 2026), and it SKIPS that plugin's whole block. The fix is the register catching up, not a new check: the comparison the report asks for already exists, and making it an error would re-open the four false alarms that made it an [INFO].
